line.name: 30th Anniversary
line.background_text: Released in 2025 to mark Rocky Patel Premium Cigars' 30th year in business (the company traces its roots to Rocky Patel's 1995 partnership with Phil Zanghi/Indian Tabac). Unveiled at the 2025 PCA trade show and rolled at Patel's Tavicusa factory in Esteli, Nicaragua, it is a box-pressed blend built around an aged Mexican San Andres wrapper, and it was also the first release to carry the company's newly redesigned band/box branding.

vitolas.summary_review: Halfwheel scored the Robusto 88, describing an earthy, chocolate-and-cream opening that develops pepper, mineral and wood notes with increasing dryness toward the finish.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Halfwheel rated the Robusto 88, noting earthy, chocolate and creamy notes that give way to pepper, mineral and wood in the back half.

research_notes: A distinct, more limited SKU called 'Thirtieth Anniversary Limited Edition' (Toro 6.5x52, box of 10, Connecticut/Nicaraguan binder rather than the standard double-Nicaraguan binder) was also released under the 30th Anniversary umbrella; treated as a separate/limited product, not one of the three core vitolas, since specs differ.
